high: Review provenance is stale for 6 of 27 AI-reviewed records: published content hashes differ from the reviewed calibration-build versions (api-bola-001-codereview-1, crypto-aead-002-codereview-1, log-ssh-bruteforce-101-misconception-1, go-path-002-codereview-1, gen-testing-007-misconception-1, det-threshold-correlation-305-checklist).

Review ledgers contain no content hashes; current apply_reviews.py requires a non-empty matching content_hash, so a fresh apply would mark all 102 reviews stale and reproduce 0 of the 27 reviewed records.

The balanced manifest describes production, not the balanced view: distributions (difficulty 11,658/2,341/1,757/107), token_lengths.records=15,863, and review_coverage.automated_screening=15,863 versus actual 5,600/2,134/1,747/107, 9,588, and 9,588. medium: final-report.md labels the balanced 6,275 deferred records as 'Rejected' although the balanced manifest has rejected_records=0 and deferred_records=6,275; production rejected 6,908 also excludes the 43 review removals.
final-report.md reports 'Reviewed records: 102' without making clear this is a calibration sample; production coverage is 27 accepted records, and the report gives 102 more prominence than 27.
DATASET_CARD.md contains conflicting figures: curated synthetic 2,061 versus source distribution 'synthetic 2,096'; Linux man-pages source 216 versus '197' (197 is the license-class count).
GOALS.md states the 13-gram screen indexed 241,515 n-grams from SecEval/baseline/smoke; the current build indexes 277,950 across six files including the three frozen eval sets.

Accepted review means recompute to 8.839 overall / 9.569 technical / 9.040 grounding over 29 accepted aggregate items, not 8.85/9.574/9.043 over 27; two accepted IDs are absent from the published corpus without explanation.
low: config_sha256 is the hash of the manifest options object, not of configs/synthesis/production.yaml; the value is self-consistent but the name is misleading.
review_quarantine.jsonl is a decision ledger without prompt/response text, license, source, or content hash, so the 43 quarantined records cannot be content-audited from it.
35 accepted records are marked pending-human-review, so 'all other accepted records automated-screened' is slightly imprecise.
DATASET_CARD token p50 is 373 while stored metadata.token_count values give 372 (not re-tokenized).
277,950 is the sum of per-file n-gram counts, not the unique union; an earlier audit reported 277,879 unique and this was not re-run.
README still describes the training corpus as pilot-v2 (7,188 records) and does not mention the 15,863/9,588 synthesis builds.
